Synopsis:
Kalshi permanently banned and fined ex-Congressman George Santos (~$71K) for manipulating prediction market bets on his own State of the Union attendance — spreading false social media claims to profit ~$18K on his wagers. The CFTC separately fined Santos last month. This follows a separate $172K CFTC penalty on a former White House teleprompter operator who traded on advance knowledge of Trump speeches. Both cases highlight growing regulatory pressure on prediction markets (Kalshi, Polymarket) to police insider trading and market manipulation as the election betting boom accelerates.
